perform 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
  where c.master_session_id=(select master_session_id from mission_generic_owner.work_items where id=p_work)
  for update;
if not found then raise exception 'MRS_V4_DIRECTOR_CURSOR_REQUIRED';end if;
perform public.master_v2_lock_scope((select master_session_id from mission_generic_owner.work_items where id=p_work));
select * into strict ww from mission_generic_owner.work_items where id=p_work for update;

 perform mission_generic_owner.work_assert(ww);
 IF mission_generic_owner.c1266_opening_named_v1(ww.master_session_id) AND mission_generic_owner.c1266_execution_authority_v1(ww.master_session_id,false,true) IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_DIRECTOR5_COMMIT_CLOSED' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 if ww.kind<>'director' or (ww.state<>'provider_started' AND NOT ((ww.id='e366b9fa-54dc-4abd-8ba6-9ceee83be9a4'::uuid AND ww.master_session_id='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid
 AND ww.kind='director' AND ww.state='failed' AND ww.receipt_id='07366817-3bf6-4bad-8387-0a4c0d1804f7'::uuid
 AND ww.dispatch_receipt_id='e9524086-1e03-42d8-866b-1c12eb77840a'::uuid
 AND ww.payload_sha256='52ae7392cc038543f01c3a9d07532a292c6f9b7cf044d52b2ce2d0a9a7b77754'
 AND ww.result_sha256='d0a4266f89198307e8c9020af67b4d2b099edc1cbf20e0aea5b38d1b78fc8ea9'
 AND public.combat_v2_sha256(ww.result)='674c8253e511750022b6d9b477383aed5743ffb2c9ceee7b35a0125c10ac6201'
 AND ww.result->>'ok'='true' AND ww.result->>'provider_calls'='1' AND ww.result->>'outcome_uncertain'='false'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 wc WHERE wc.work_id=ww.id AND wc.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id
  AND wc.contract_sha256='0c4e3f0016df29ed7b740336e90ba58d6b1e8d72ac21ed144b9796d32073ecce'
  AND wc.contract_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(wc.contract) AND wc.release_sha256='e58e2e460469dced1c6efb98858b23f043fe8976988ae15bcb25525becc70cd8')
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts dr JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit ga ON ga.receipt_id=dr.id AND ga.event_code='generic_finalized'
  JOIN staff_ai_quota_private.calls q ON q.source_id=dr.id AND q.producer='mission_generic_ai' AND q.call_no=1 AND q.scope_id=ww.master_session_id AND q.state='settled' AND q.charged_usd=dr.charged_cost_usd
  WHERE dr.id=ww.dispatch_receipt_id AND dr.status='success' AND dr.dispatch_count=1 AND dr.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
   AND dr.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id AND dr.authority_receipt_id=ww.id AND dr.request_key=ww.request_key
   AND ga.details->>'work_id'=ww.id::text AND ga.details->>'receipt_id'=ww.receipt_id::text
   AND ga.details->>'application_error_sqlstate'='54000' AND ga.details->'command_receipt'='null'::jsonb
   AND ga.details->>'stale'='false' AND ga.details->>'outcome_uncertain'='false'
   AND ga.details->>'result_sha256'=ww.result_sha256 AND ga.details->>'result_jsonb_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(ww.result))
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness rr WHERE rr.singleton AND rr.state='enabled'
  AND rr.revision_sha256=rr.observed_revision_sha256 AND rr.revision_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(rr.canonical_preimage,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
  AND rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>'{config,c1266_raw_input_recovery,schema_version}'='c1266-raw-input-recovery/1'
  AND rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>'{config,c1266_raw_input_recovery,failed_work_id}'=ww.id::text
  AND rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>'{config,c1266_raw_input_recovery,result_sha256}'=ww.result_sha256
  AND rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>'{config,c1266_raw_input_recovery,commit_source_md5}'=(SELECT md5(p.prosrc)FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid='mission_generic_owner.unified_director_commit(uuid,jsonb)'::regprocedure)
  AND rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>'{config,c1266_raw_input_recovery,cached_source_md5}'=(SELECT md5(p.prosrc)FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid='public.mission_generic_staff_republish_failed_v1(uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure))) AND p_decision IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ww.result->'decision')) then raise exception 'MUF_DIRECTOR_WORK';end if;
 select * into strict uw from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows where id=ww.authority_receipt_id and work_id=ww.id for update;
 if uw.master_session_id<>ww.master_session_id or uw.step_key<>ww.step_key or uw.run_control_version<>ww.run_control_version
 or uw.definition_sha256<>ww.definition_sha256 or uw.source_sha256<>ww.payload_sha256 or uw.context is distinct from ww.payload->'context'
 or uw.opportunities is distinct from ww.payload->'opportunities' then raise exception 'MUF_WINDOW_BINDING';end if;
 if exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(uw.context->'sources') source_role where source_role->>'kind'='role' and not exists(
  select 1 from public.messages sm where sm.id=(source_role->>'id')::uuid and sm.body=source_role->>'body' and sm.recipient_user is null
  and encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(sm.body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')=source_role->>'sha256')) then raise exception 'MUF_DIRECTOR_ROLE_DRIFT';end if;
 IF ww.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-director-work/4' THEN
  IF NOT mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_scope_v2(ww.master_session_id,true) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_TEMPORAL_COMMIT_SCOPE' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
  c1266_bundle:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_decision_v2(ww.id,p_decision);
  p_decision:=c1266_bundle->'original_core_decision';
 END IF;
 IF ww.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-director-work/3' THEN
  c1266_bundle:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_decision_v1(ww.id,p_decision);
  p_decision:=c1266_bundle->'original_core_decision';
 END IF;
 select * into ub from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches where decision_work_id=ww.id;
 if found then
  if ub.decision is distinct from coalesce(c1266_bundle->'stored_decision',p_decision) then raise exception 'MUF_DECISION_REPLAY';end if;return jsonb_build_object('batch_id',ub.id,'state',ub.state);
 end if;
 is_v2:=ww.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-director-work/2' OR c1266_bundle IS NOT NULL;
 expected_schema:='mission-director-proposal/1';
 if is_v2 then expected_schema:='mission-director-proposal/2';end if;
 if not mission_generic_owner.keys_valid(p_decision,array['schema_version','source_window_id','source_role_ids','source_evidence','opportunity_id','action_kind','entry_side','world_reaction_intent','npc_intents'])
 or p_decision->>'schema_version' is distinct from expected_schema or p_decision->>'source_window_id' is distinct from uw.id::text
 or jsonb_typeof(p_decision->'source_role_ids') is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_array_length(p_decision->'source_role_ids')=0
 or jsonb_typeof(p_decision->'source_evidence') is distinct from 'array'
 or jsonb_array_length(p_decision->'source_evidence')>8
 or jsonb_array_length(p_decision->'source_evidence')=0
 or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_decision->'source_evidence') ev
  where not mission_generic_owner.keys_valid(ev,array['role_id','quote'])
   or ev->>'role_id' is null or not ((ev->>'role_id')::uuid=any(uw.role_ids))
   or not (p_decision->'source_role_ids' ? (ev->>'role_id'))
   or nullif(btrim(ev->>'quote'),'') is null or length(ev->>'quote')>300
   or not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(uw.context->'sources') ss
    where ss->>'kind'='role' and ss->>'id'=ev->>'role_id'
     and position(ev->>'quote' in ss->>'body')>0))
 or (exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows prior_window
   join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches prior_batch on prior_batch.source_window_id=prior_window.id
   where prior_window.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id and prior_window.step_key=ww.step_key
    and prior_window.run_control_version=ww.run_control_version
    and prior_batch.composition_kind='narrative_continuation' and prior_batch.state='published')
  and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_decision->'source_evidence') ev
   join public.messages fresh_role on fresh_role.id=(ev->>'role_id')::uuid
   where (exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors current_cursor
      join mission_generic_owner.role_latest_v1(ww.master_session_id) latest
        on latest.message_id=fresh_role.id and latest.valid
      where current_cursor.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id)
    or (not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors current_cursor
      where current_cursor.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id)
      and fresh_role.created_at>(select max(prior_fato.created_at)
       from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows prior_window
       join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches prior_batch on prior_batch.source_window_id=prior_window.id
       join public.messages prior_fato on prior_fato.id=prior_batch.message_id
       where prior_window.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id and prior_window.step_key=ww.step_key
        and prior_window.run_control_version=ww.run_control_version
        and prior_batch.composition_kind='narrative_continuation' and prior_batch.state='published')))))
 or jsonb_typeof(p_decision->'action_kind') is distinct from 'string'
 or jsonb_typeof(p_decision->'npc_intents') is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_typeof(p_decision->'world_reaction_intent') is distinct from 'string'
 or length(p_decision->>'world_reaction_intent')>2500
 or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements_text(p_decision->'source_role_ids') rr where not(rr::uuid=any(uw.role_ids)))
 then raise exception 'MUF_DIRECTOR_PROPOSAL_INVALID';end if;
 sc:=mission_generic_owner.scene(ww.master_session_id,ww.step_key);
 if p_decision->>'opportunity_id' is not null then
  select op into strict opportunity from jsonb_array_elements(uw.opportunities) op where op->>'opportunity_id'=p_decision->>'opportunity_id';
  if p_decision->>'action_kind' is distinct from opportunity->>'action_kind' then raise exception 'MUF_DIRECTOR_ACTION_KIND';end if;
  if opportunity#>>'{destination_context,step_key}' is not null then
   sc:=mission_generic_owner.scene(ww.master_session_id,opportunity#>>'{destination_context,step_key}');
  end if;
 elsif p_decision->>'action_kind' is distinct from 'context' then raise exception 'MUF_DIRECTOR_CONTEXT_KIND';
 end if;
 if is_v2 then
  select coalesce(array_agg(ni->>'actor_key'),'{}') into intent_keys from jsonb_array_elements(p_decision->'npc_intents') ni;
  select coalesce(array_agg(ni->>'actor_key'),'{}') into nk from jsonb_array_elements(p_decision->'npc_intents') ni
    where ni->>'entry_kind'='offense';
  -- Context is a real scene: visible PNG may act without a transition.
  -- A synthetic non-combat opportunity reuses the existing entry-policy guard.
  if opportunity is null and cardinality(intent_keys)>0 then
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'allowed_actor_keys',coalesce(to_jsonb(array_agg(actor->>'actor_key')),'[]'::jsonb),
      'destination_entry_candidates',coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'actor_key',actor->>'actor_key','visible_on_enter',true,
        'visibility_trigger_key',null,
        'entry_capabilities',coalesce(actor#>'{entry_policy,entry_capabilities}',
          '["speak","gesture","utility"]'::jsonb)-'offense',
        'offense_allowed',false)),'[]'::jsonb),
      'destination_context',uw.context,'trigger_key',null,'encounter_key',null)
    into opportunity
    from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'actors') actor
    where mission_generic_owner.npc_entry_actor_visible(
      ww.master_session_id,ww.step_key,actor->>'actor_key',null)
      and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(uw.context->'actors') ca
        where ca->>'id'='png:'||(actor->>'actor_key'));
  end if;
  if cardinality(intent_keys)<>(select count(distinct actor_key) from unnest(intent_keys) actor_key)
    or (opportunity is null and cardinality(intent_keys)>0)
    or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_decision->'npc_intents') ni
      where not mission_generic_owner.keys_valid(ni,array['actor_key','intent','entry_kind','speech_intent'])
        or jsonb_typeof(ni->'intent')<>'string' or length(ni->>'intent')>1500
        or ni->>'entry_kind' not in('speak','gesture','utility','offense')
        or jsonb_typeof(ni->'speech_intent') not in('null','string')
        or length(coalesce(ni->>'speech_intent',''))>700
        or (ni->>'speech_intent' is not null and ni->>'entry_kind' not in('speak','offense'))
        or (ni->>'speech_intent' is not null and ni->>'entry_kind'='speak'
          and not exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_sessions staff_session
            where staff_session.id=ww.master_session_id
              and staff_session.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid))
        or not (
          exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(opportunity->'destination_entry_candidates','[]'::jsonb)) candidate
            where candidate->>'actor_key'=ni->>'actor_key'
              and (candidate->>'visible_on_enter'='true' or
                (candidate->>'visibility_trigger_key' is not null and candidate->>'visibility_trigger_key'=opportunity->>'trigger_key')
                or (opportunity->>'trigger_key' is null
                  and mission_generic_owner.npc_entry_actor_visible(ww.master_session_id,ww.step_key,
                    candidate->>'actor_key',null)))
              and candidate->'entry_capabilities' ? (ni->>'entry_kind')
              and (ni->>'speech_intent' is null or candidate->'entry_capabilities' ? 'speak')
              and ((ni->>'entry_kind'<>'speak' and ni->>'speech_intent' is null)
                or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(opportunity#>'{destination_context,actors}',uw.context->'actors','[]'::jsonb)) context_actor
                  where context_actor->>'id'='png:'||(ni->>'actor_key') and context_actor->>'may_speak'='true'))
              and (ni->>'entry_kind'<>'offense' or candidate->>'offense_allowed'='true'))
          or (opportunity->'allowed_actor_keys' ? (ni->>'actor_key')
            and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'actors') legacy_actor
              where legacy_actor->>'actor_key'=ni->>'actor_key'
                and not (legacy_actor ? 'entry_policy'))
            and (ni->>'entry_kind'<>'speak' or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(opportunity#>'{destination_context,actors}',uw.context->'actors','[]'::jsonb)) context_actor
              where context_actor->>'id'='png:'||(ni->>'actor_key') and context_actor->>'may_speak'='true'))
            and (ni->>'speech_intent' is null or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(opportunity#>'{destination_context,actors}',uw.context->'actors','[]'::jsonb)) context_actor
              where context_actor->>'id'='png:'||(ni->>'actor_key') and context_actor->>'may_speak'='true'))))
        )
  then raise exception 'MNE_DIRECTOR_ENTRY_INVALID' using errcode='22023';end if;
  if cardinality(nk)>0 and (opportunity->>'encounter_key' is null or p_decision->>'entry_side'<>'png')
  then raise exception 'MNE_OFFENSE_ENCOUNTER_REQUIRED' using errcode='42501';end if;
  if p_decision->>'entry_side'='png' and cardinality(nk)=0
  then raise exception 'MNE_OFFENSE_INITIATOR_REQUIRED' using errcode='22023';end if;
  if p_decision->>'entry_side' is null and cardinality(nk)=0 and opportunity is not null then
   opportunity:=jsonb_set(opportunity,'{encounter_key}','null'::jsonb);
  end if;
 else
  select coalesce(array_agg(ni->>'actor_key'),'{}') into nk from jsonb_array_elements(p_decision->'npc_intents') ni;
  if cardinality(nk)<>(select count(distinct ak) from unnest(nk) ak)
    or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_decision->'npc_intents') ni
      where not mission_generic_owner.keys_valid(ni,array['actor_key','intent'])
        or jsonb_typeof(ni->'intent') is distinct from 'string' or length(ni->>'intent')>1500
        or not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'actors') aa where aa->>'actor_key'=ni->>'actor_key'))
  then raise exception 'MUF_DIRECTOR_ACTORS';end if;
  if opportunity is not null and exists(select 1 from unnest(nk) offered_actor where not(opportunity->'allowed_actor_keys' ? offered_actor))
  then raise exception 'MUF_INTENT_NOT_OFFERED';end if;
 end if;
 if opportunity->>'encounter_key' is not null then
  if opportunity->>'trigger_key' is not null then
    if (p_decision->>'entry_side'<>'ambiguous'
      and not (opportunity->'allowed_entry_sides' ? (p_decision->>'entry_side')))
      or (sc ? 'arrival_conflict' and (sc#>>'{arrival_conflict,encounter_key}' is distinct from opportunity->>'encounter_key'
        or (p_decision->>'entry_side'<>'ambiguous' and sc#>>'{arrival_conflict,entry_side}' is distinct from p_decision->>'entry_side')))
      or (not(sc ? 'arrival_conflict') and not mission_generic_owner.mandatory_arrival(
        (select plan_version_id from public.mission_run_state where master_session_id=ww.master_session_id),sc)
       and not (is_v2 and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(opportunity->'destination_entry_candidates') candidate
         where candidate->>'offense_allowed'='true' and candidate->>'visible_on_enter'='true')))
    then raise exception 'MFC_ARRIVAL_CONFLICT_NOT_CERTIFIED' using errcode='42501';end if;
  elsif not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.work_items intro
    join public.messages fato on fato.id=intro.message_id and fato.kind='fato' and fato.recipient_user is null
    where intro.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id and intro.kind='narration' and intro.state='completed'
      and intro.step_key=ww.step_key and intro.run_control_version=ww.run_control_version
      and exists(select 1 from public.messages role_msg
        where role_msg.id=any(uw.role_ids) and role_msg.created_at>fato.created_at
          and role_msg.id::text=any(select jsonb_array_elements_text(p_decision->'source_role_ids'))))
  then raise exception 'MFC_CONTACT_OR_NEW_ROLE_REQUIRED' using errcode='42501';end if;
  select es into strict spec from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'encounters') es where es->>'encounter_key'=opportunity->>'encounter_key';
  if p_decision->>'entry_side' not in('pg','png','ambiguous') or p_decision->>'entry_side' is null then raise exception 'MUF_ENTRY_SIDE';end if;
  if p_decision->>'entry_side'='png' and (cardinality(nk)=0
   or (not is_v2 and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(spec->'actors') aa
    where aa->>'team'<>spec->>'pg_team' and not ((aa->>'actor_key')=any(nk))
     and not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
      where ar.mission_id=(select mission_id from public.master_v2_sessions where id=ww.master_session_id)
       and ar.actor_key=aa->>'actor_key' and ar.active
       and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p where p.session_id=ww.master_session_id
        and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster)))
   or exists(select 1 from unnest(nk) ak where not exists(
    select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(spec->'actors') aa where aa->>'actor_key'=ak and aa->>'team'<>spec->>'pg_team')))
  then raise exception 'MUF_PNG_INITIATIVE_COHORT';end if;
 elsif p_decision->>'entry_side' is not null then raise exception 'MUF_ENTRY_WITHOUT_ENCOUNTER';end if;
 -- All original source/actor/entry-policy checks above ran on the ORIGINAL proposal.
 -- Only after those checks may a well-formed incompatible effect become context.
 IF c1266_bundle IS NOT NULL THEN
  p_decision:=c1266_bundle->'effective_core_decision';
  IF c1266_bundle#>>'{role_disposition,status}'='context_fallback' THEN
   opportunity:=NULL;spec:=NULL;nk:='{}'::text[];intent_keys:='{}'::text[];
   sc:=mission_generic_owner.scene(ww.master_session_id,ww.step_key);
  END IF;
 END IF;
 insert into mission_generic_owner.unified_batches(master_session_id,step_key,run_control_version,entry_side,pg_team,selected_actor_keys,state,
 source_window_id,decision_work_id,decision,decision_sha256,composition_kind,encounter_key,context)
 values(ww.master_session_id,ww.step_key,ww.run_control_version,case when p_decision->>'entry_side'='ambiguous' then null else p_decision->>'entry_side' end,
 spec->>'pg_team',nk,case when p_decision->>'entry_side'='ambiguous' then 'needs_review' else 'preparing' end,uw.id,ww.id,p_decision,
 public.combat_v2_sha256(p_decision),case when opportunity->>'encounter_key' is null then 'narrative_continuation' else 'entry_'||(p_decision->>'entry_side') end,
 opportunity->>'encounter_key',uw.context) returning * into ub;

 IF c1266_bundle IS NOT NULL THEN
  UPDATE mission_generic_owner.unified_batches SET decision=c1266_bundle->'stored_decision',
   decision_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(c1266_bundle->'stored_decision') WHERE id=ub.id RETURNING * INTO ub;
 END IF;
 if ub.state='needs_review' then return jsonb_build_object('batch_id',ub.id,'state','needs_review');end if;

 if not is_v2 then raise exception 'MRS_V4_DIRECTOR_PROPOSAL_V2_REQUIRED';end if;
 if coalesce(uw.context->>'source_revision','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   or uw.context->>'source_revision' is distinct from mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(ww.master_session_id)
 then raise exception 'MRS_V4_DIRECTOR_STALE_ROLE' using errcode='40001';end if;
 if opportunity->>'trigger_key' is not null
   and jsonb_typeof(opportunity->'destination_context') is distinct from 'object'
 then raise exception 'MRS_V4_DESTINATION_CONTEXT_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000';end if;
 if is_v2 and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_decision->'npc_intents') ni
   where ni->>'entry_kind'='offense' and ni->>'actor_key' !~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$')
 then raise exception 'MRS_V4_DIRECTOR_SLOT_KEY';end if;
 if opportunity->>'quest_terminal_decision_key' is not null then return mission_factory_owner.quest_terminal_director_v1(ub.id,opportunity->>'quest_terminal_decision_key');end if;
 update mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b set
   selected_actor_keys=coalesce((select array_agg(ni->>'actor_key' order by ni->>'actor_key')
     from jsonb_array_elements(p_decision->'npc_intents') ni where ni->>'entry_kind'='offense'),'{}'::text[]),
   context=mission_generic_owner.npc_entry_visible_context(
     jsonb_set(
       jsonb_set(coalesce(opportunity->'destination_context',uw.context),
         '{source_revision}',to_jsonb(uw.context->>'source_revision'),true),
       '{resolved_facts}',
       coalesce(coalesce(opportunity->'destination_context',uw.context)->'resolved_facts','{}'::jsonb)
         || case when opportunity->>'encounter_key' is not null
              and opportunity->>'trigger_key' is not null
              and coalesce(opportunity#>>'{destination_context,step_key}',ww.step_key)<>ww.step_key
            then jsonb_build_object('arrival_conflict',jsonb_build_object(
              'encounter_key',opportunity->>'encounter_key',
              'entry_side',p_decision->>'entry_side',
              'public_cause',opportunity->>'label'))
            else '{}'::jsonb end,true),
     mission_generic_owner.scene(ww.master_session_id,
       coalesce(opportunity#>>'{destination_context,step_key}',ww.step_key)),ub.id)
 where b.id=ub.id;
 perform mission_generic_owner.unified_enqueue_writer(ub.id);
 return jsonb_build_object('batch_id',ub.id,'state','writer_ready');
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.unified_enqueue_director(p_session uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare mr public.mission_run_state;rb mission_generic_owner.run_bindings;ctx jsonb;sc jsonb;opps jsonb:='[]';
 item jsonb;destctx jsonb;destscene jsonb;destspec jsonb;deststep text;wid uuid:=gen_random_uuid();cutoff timestamptz:=clock_timestamp();opening_at timestamptz;last_context_at timestamptz;ids uuid[];fresh_ids uuid[];sw uuid;payload jsonb;final_trigger text;last_writer mission_generic_owner.work_items;final_fato public.messages;final_route jsonb;
begin

 if not mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(p_session) then return mission_generic_owner.flow_previous_unified_enqueue_director(p_session);end if; 
perform mission_ai_board_owner.service_only();
if exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
  where c.master_session_id=p_session) then
  perform 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
    where c.master_session_id=p_session for update;
  if exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_reissues ri
    where ri.master_session_id=p_session and ri.state='armed') then
    raise exception 'MRS_V4_LEGACY_REISSUE_ACTIVE' using errcode='40001';
  end if;
end if;
perform mission_generic_owner.assert_runtime(p_session);

 perform public.master_v2_lock_scope(p_session);
 select * into strict mr from public.mission_run_state where master_session_id=p_session;
 select * into strict rb from mission_generic_owner.run_bindings where master_session_id=p_session;
 if exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows uw where uw.master_session_id=p_session and uw.consumed_message_id is null and uw.superseded_at is null)
 then return jsonb_build_object('state','window_pending');end if;
 -- Academy valuation is complete only after the Fato for the preceding transition is published.
 -- The terminal route is a server receipt, not an invented PG role or a player click.
 if mission_academy_owner.is_academy(mr.mission_id) and mr.current_step_key='valutazione' then
  if exists(select 1 from public.combat_v2_sessions cs where cs.master_session_id=p_session and
   (cs.state<>'chiuso' or cs.closed_at is null))
   or exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
    where wi.master_session_id=p_session and wi.state<>'completed'
      and not (exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
        where c.master_session_id=p_session)
        and wi.state='failed'
        and (wi.result->>'reason'='new_role_before_provider'
          or exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows stale_window
            left join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches stale_batch
              on stale_batch.source_window_id=stale_window.id
            where stale_window.master_session_id=p_session
              and mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(stale_window.id)
              and (stale_window.work_id=wi.id or stale_batch.writer_work_id=wi.id)))))
  then return jsonb_build_object('state','waiting_publication');end if;
  select wi.* into last_writer from mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
   join public.messages msg on msg.id=wi.message_id and msg.kind='fato' and msg.recipient_user is null
   left join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub on ub.writer_work_id=wi.id and ub.state='published'
   where wi.master_session_id=p_session and wi.kind='narration' and wi.state='completed'
    and (wi.step_key='valutazione' and wi.run_control_version=mr.control_version
     or ub.composition_kind='combat_exit' and ub.route->>'to_step_key'='valutazione')
   order by wi.finalized_at desc,wi.id desc limit 1;
  if last_writer.id is null then return jsonb_build_object('state','waiting_publication');end if;
  select * into strict final_fato from public.messages where id=last_writer.message_id and kind='fato' and recipient_user is null;
  select t.value->>'trigger_key' into strict final_trigger
   from jsonb_array_elements(mission_generic_owner.scene(p_session,'valutazione')->'triggers') as t(value)
   join public.mission_plan_transitions pt on pt.plan_version_id=mr.plan_version_id
    and pt.from_step_key='valutazione' and pt.transition_key=t.value->>'transition_key'
   where t.value->>'source_kind'='narrative_event' and pt.to_step_key='rapid_success';
  final_route:=mission_generic_owner.apply_authority(p_session,
   mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(p_session,'academy-final:'||mr.control_version),
   (select control_version from public.master_v2_sessions where id=p_session),mr.control_version,
   final_trigger,'narrative_event',last_writer.message_id,
   encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(final_fato.body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),null);
  perform mission_generic_owner.enqueue_transition(p_session,(final_route->>'authority_receipt_id')::uuid);
  return jsonb_build_object('state','terminal_narration_ready','transition',final_route);
 end if;
 ctx:=mission_generic_owner.narrative_context(p_session,mr.current_step_key,wid,cutoff,'{}');
 if ctx->>'schema_version'<>'mission-narrative-context/2' then raise exception 'MUF_CREATION_CONTEXT_REQUIRED';end if;
 if exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources where session_id=p_session) then
   select msg.created_at into strict opening_at from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources q
     join public.mission_run_messages rm on rm.publication_id=q.opening_publication_id
     join public.messages msg on msg.id=rm.message_id and msg.kind='fato' and msg.recipient_user is null
     where q.session_id=p_session and q.state='started';
 else
 select msg.created_at into strict opening_at from mission_generic_owner.board_starts bs
 join mission_generic_owner.work_items ow on ow.master_session_id=bs.master_session_id
 and ow.payload->>'opening_start_receipt_id'=bs.id::text and ow.kind='narration' and ow.state='completed'
 join public.messages msg on msg.id=ow.message_id and msg.kind='fato' and msg.recipient_user is null
 where bs.master_session_id=p_session and bs.state='published';
 end if;
 -- The opening is mandatory. Roles before its real publication cannot answer it.
 ctx:=jsonb_set(ctx,'{sources}',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(sr order by ord),'[]')
 from jsonb_array_elements(ctx->'sources') with ordinality z(sr,ord)
 where sr->>'kind'<>'role' or exists(select 1 from public.messages rm where rm.id::text=sr->>'id'
 and rm.created_at>opening_at and nullif(btrim(rm.body),'') is not null)));

 -- Solo reissue esplicito della precedente finestra Suna già pubblicata.
 -- Il contesto attuale conserva nuovo piano, Creation e autorità; si recuperano
 -- soltanto le fonti pubbliche originarie (role e Fato antecedente), non
 -- la prosa ormai superata dell'ultimo Fato.
 if not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
     where c.master_session_id=p_session)
   and p_session='b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
   and mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(p_session)
   and exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_reissues ri
     where ri.master_session_id=p_session and ri.state='armed') then
   if (select count(*) from mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_reissues ri
      join mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows old
        on old.id=ri.old_window_id and old.master_session_id=ri.master_session_id
      where ri.master_session_id=p_session and ri.state='armed'
        and old.consumed_message_id=ri.old_fato_id
        and old.superseded_at is not null
        and old.role_ids=ri.role_ids
        and jsonb_typeof(old.context->'sources')='array'
        and (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(old.context->'sources') src
          where src->>'kind'='role')=3
        and (select array_agg((src->>'id')::uuid order by (src->>'sequence')::bigint)
          from jsonb_array_elements(old.context->'sources') src
          where src->>'kind'='role')=ri.role_ids
        and not exists(select 1 from unnest(ri.role_ids) role(role_id)
          where not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(old.context->'sources') src
            join public.messages msg on msg.id=role.role_id
            where src->>'id'=role.role_id::text and src->>'kind'='role'
              and src->>'body'=msg.body
              and src->>'sha256'=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(msg.body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
              and msg.kind='say' and msg.recipient_user is null)))<>1
   then raise exception 'SUNAV3_REISSUE_SOURCE_DRIFT' using errcode='40001';end if;
   ctx:=jsonb_set(ctx,'{sources}',(select old.context->'sources'
      from mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_reissues ri
      join mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows old on old.id=ri.old_window_id
      where ri.master_session_id=p_session and ri.state='armed'),true);
 end if;
 select array_agg((v->>'id')::uuid order by (v->>'sequence')::bigint) into ids from jsonb_array_elements(ctx->'sources') v where v->>'kind'='role';
 select max(fato.created_at) into last_context_at from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows uw
  join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub on ub.source_window_id=uw.id
  join public.messages fato on fato.id=ub.message_id and fato.kind='fato' and fato.recipient_user is null
  where uw.master_session_id=p_session and uw.step_key=mr.current_step_key
   and uw.run_control_version=mr.control_version and ub.composition_kind='narrative_continuation'
   and ub.state='published';
 -- Older roles remain narrative context; every participant answers the latest published Fato.
 if exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
    where c.master_session_id=p_session) then
   select array_agg(lr.message_id order by lr.submission_order) into fresh_ids
     from mission_generic_owner.role_latest_v1(p_session) lr
     where lr.valid and lr.message_id=any(ids);
  else
   select array_agg(rm.id order by rm.created_at,rm.id) into fresh_ids
     from public.messages rm where rm.id=any(ids)
       and rm.created_at>coalesce(last_context_at,opening_at);
  end if;
 -- Eccezione monouso: solo le tre role della finestra Suna Staff con reissue
 -- esplicito, gia' validate sopra e col Fato precedente marcato superato.
 if not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
     where c.master_session_id=p_session)
   and p_session='b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
   and exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_reissues ri
     join mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows old
       on old.id=ri.old_window_id and old.master_session_id=ri.master_session_id
     where ri.master_session_id=p_session and ri.state='armed'
       and ri.role_ids=ids and cardinality(ids)=3
       and old.consumed_message_id=ri.old_fato_id
       and old.superseded_at is not null)
 then fresh_ids:=ids;end if;
 if not (case when exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
    where c.master_session_id=p_session)
  then mission_generic_owner.role_window_ready_v1(p_session,fresh_ids,cutoff)
  else mission_generic_owner.unified_roles_ready(p_session,fresh_ids,cutoff) end)
 then return jsonb_build_object('state','waiting_roles');end if;
 sc:=mission_generic_owner.scene(p_session,mr.current_step_key);
 for item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'encounters') loop
  if not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.encounters ee where ee.master_session_id=p_session
    and ee.run_control_version=mr.control_version and ee.encounter_key=item->>'encounter_key')
   and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(item->'actors') encounter_actor
    where not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
      where ar.mission_id=mr.mission_id and ar.actor_key=encounter_actor->>'actor_key' and ar.active
        and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p
          where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster)
      and not mission_generic_owner.npc_entry_actor_visible(p_session,mr.current_step_key,
        encounter_actor->>'actor_key',null)) then
   opps:=opps||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('opportunity_id',mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(wid,'encounter:'||(item->>'encounter_key')),
    'trigger_key',null,'source_kind',null,'label','Scontro possibile nella scena','action_kind','conflict','destination_context',case when exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'actors') entry_actor where entry_actor ? 'entry_policy' and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(item->'actors') encounter_actor where encounter_actor->>'actor_key'=entry_actor->>'actor_key')) then jsonb_set(ctx,'{sources}',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(source_item),'[]'::jsonb) from jsonb_array_elements(ctx->'sources') source_item where source_item->>'kind'='setting')) else null end,'encounter_key',item->>'encounter_key','allowed_entry_sides',jsonb_build_array('pg','png'),
    'destination_entry_candidates',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('actor_key',entry_actor->>'actor_key',
      'visible_on_enter',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,visible_on_enter}',
      'visibility_trigger_key',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,visibility_trigger_key}',
      'entry_capabilities',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,entry_capabilities}',
      'offense_allowed',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,offense_allowed}') order by ord),'[]'::jsonb)
     from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'actors') with ordinality current_actors(entry_actor,ord)
     where entry_actor ? 'entry_policy' and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(item->'actors') encounter_actor
       where encounter_actor->>'actor_key'=entry_actor->>'actor_key')
       and not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
       where ar.mission_id=mr.mission_id and ar.actor_key=entry_actor->>'actor_key' and ar.active
         and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster)),
    'allowed_actor_keys',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(aa->>'actor_key'),'[]') from jsonb_array_elements(item->'actors') aa
    where not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
     where ar.mission_id=mr.mission_id and ar.actor_key=aa->>'actor_key' and ar.active
      and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p
       where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster))));
  end if;
 end loop;
 for item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'triggers') where value->>'source_kind' in('narrative_event','player_choice')
  and not (mission_academy_owner.is_academy(mr.mission_id) and value->>'fact_code' in('academy_d100_success','academy_d100_complication')) loop
  select pt.to_step_key into strict deststep from public.mission_plan_transitions pt where pt.plan_version_id=mr.plan_version_id
   and pt.from_step_key=mr.current_step_key and pt.transition_key=item->>'transition_key';
  destscene:=mission_generic_owner.scene(p_session,deststep);destspec:=null;destctx:=null;
  if EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 ma WHERE ma.master_session_id=p_session) OR exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c where c.master_session_id=p_session)
    or jsonb_array_length(destscene->'encounters')=1
    or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(destscene->'actors') entry_actor where entry_actor ? 'entry_policy') then
   destspec:=case when destscene ? 'arrival_conflict'
     or mission_generic_owner.mandatory_arrival(mr.plan_version_id,destscene)
     or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(destscene->'actors') entry_actor
       where entry_actor#>>'{entry_policy,offense_allowed}'='true' and entry_actor#>>'{entry_policy,visible_on_enter}'='true')
    then destscene->'encounters'->0 else null end;
   -- La topologia obbligatoria del piano approvato mantiene l'ingaggio; il marker ne precisa causa e lato.
   if destspec is not null and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(destspec->'actors') encounter_actor
      left join lateral (select a->'entry_policy' policy from jsonb_array_elements(destscene->'actors') a
        where a->>'actor_key'=encounter_actor->>'actor_key') actor_policy on true
      where actor_policy.policy is not null
        and not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
          where ar.mission_id=mr.mission_id and ar.actor_key=encounter_actor->>'actor_key' and ar.active
            and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p
              where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster)
        and actor_policy.policy->>'visible_on_enter'='false'
        and actor_policy.policy->>'visibility_trigger_key' is distinct from item->>'trigger_key')
   then destspec:=null;end if;
   destctx:=mission_generic_owner.narrative_context(p_session,deststep,wid,cutoff,
     jsonb_build_object('entry_preview','private'));
   destctx:=jsonb_set(destctx,'{sources}',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(ds),'[]') from jsonb_array_elements(destctx->'sources') ds where ds->>'kind'='setting'));
  end if;
  opps:=opps||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('opportunity_id',mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(wid,'trigger:'||(item->>'trigger_key')),
   'trigger_key',item->>'trigger_key','source_kind',item->>'source_kind','label',left(item->>'label'||case when destspec is null then ''
    else ' Causa visibile: '||coalesce(destscene#>>'{arrival_conflict,public_cause}',
      nullif(btrim(destctx#>>'{director_context,entry_public}'),''),item->>'label') end,300),
   'action_kind',case when item->>'source_kind'='player_choice' then item->>'trigger_key' else coalesce(item->>'fact_code','phase_transition') end,'destination_context',destctx,'encounter_key',destspec->>'encounter_key',
   'allowed_entry_sides',case when destspec is null then '[]'::jsonb
    when destscene ? 'arrival_conflict' then jsonb_build_array(destscene#>>'{arrival_conflict,entry_side}')
    else jsonb_build_array('pg','png') end,
   'destination_entry_candidates',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('actor_key',entry_actor->>'actor_key',
     'visible_on_enter',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,visible_on_enter}',
     'visibility_trigger_key',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,visibility_trigger_key}',
     'entry_capabilities',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,entry_capabilities}',
     'offense_allowed',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,offense_allowed}') order by ord),'[]'::jsonb)
     from jsonb_array_elements(destscene->'actors') with ordinality actors(entry_actor,ord)
     where entry_actor ? 'entry_policy' and not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
       where ar.mission_id=mr.mission_id and ar.actor_key=entry_actor->>'actor_key' and ar.active
         and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster)),
   'allowed_actor_keys',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(aa->>'actor_key'),'[]') from jsonb_array_elements(case when destctx is null then '[]'::jsonb else destscene->'actors' end) aa
    where not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
     where ar.mission_id=mr.mission_id and ar.actor_key=aa->>'actor_key' and ar.active
      and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p
       where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster))));
 end loop;
 if exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(opps) candidate_op
   where jsonb_array_length(coalesce(candidate_op->'destination_entry_candidates','[]'::jsonb))>0) then
   select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_set(candidate_op,'{allowed_actor_keys}',
     coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(legacy_key))
       from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(candidate_op->'allowed_actor_keys','[]'::jsonb)) as legacy_keys(legacy_key)
       where not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(candidate_op->'destination_entry_candidates','[]'::jsonb)) policy_actor
         where policy_actor->>'actor_key'=legacy_key)),'[]'::jsonb)) order by ord),'[]'::jsonb)
     into opps from jsonb_array_elements(opps) with ordinality opportunities(candidate_op,ord);
   payload:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-director-work/2','source_window_id',wid,'context',ctx,'opportunities',opps);
 else
   if not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
     where c.master_session_id=p_session) then
     select coalesce(jsonb_agg(candidate_op-'destination_entry_candidates' order by ord),'[]'::jsonb) into opps
       from jsonb_array_elements(opps) with ordinality opportunities(candidate_op,ord);
   end if;
   
payload:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version',
  case when exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
    where c.master_session_id=p_session) then 'mission-director-work/2'
    else 'mission-director-work/1' end,
  'source_window_id',wid,'context',ctx,'opportunities',opps);

 end if;
 sw:=wid;
 if exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources where session_id=p_session) then
   select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
     'opportunity_id',mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(wid,'quest-terminal:'||(opt->>'decision_key')),
     'quest_terminal_decision_key',opt->>'decision_key','trigger_key',null,'source_kind','narrative_event',
     'label',opt->>'decision_key','action_kind','quest_terminal','destination_context',null,
     'encounter_key',null,'allowed_entry_sides','[]'::jsonb,'allowed_actor_keys','[]'::jsonb) order by opt->>'decision_key'),'[]'::jsonb)||opps
   into opps from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'terminal_options') opt
   join mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources q on q.session_id=p_session
   join mission_generic_owner.definitions df on df.id=q.definition_id
   join mission_factory_owner.quest_decision_registry reg on reg.catalog_version=df.definition->>'catalog_version'
     and reg.catalog_sha256=df.definition->>'catalog_sha256' and reg.capability_key='terminal.result'
     and reg.decision_key=opt->>'decision_key' and reg.qualified and reg.terminal_route
     and reg.step_kind='narrative' and reg.trigger_source_kind='narrative_event';
   payload:=jsonb_set(payload,'{opportunities}',opps);
   payload:=mission_factory_owner.quest_step_payload_v1(p_session,sw,payload);
 end if;
 IF mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_scope_v2(p_session,true) THEN
  ctx:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_progression_context_v2(p_session,ctx);
  payload:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_prepare_v2(p_session,sw,ctx,opps);
  ctx:=payload->'context';opps:=payload->'opportunities';
 ELSIF mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_scope_v1(p_session,true) THEN
  ctx:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_progression_context_v1(p_session,ctx);
  payload:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_prepare_v1(p_session,sw,ctx,opps);
  ctx:=payload->'context';opps:=payload->'opportunities';
 END IF;
 insert into mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows(id,master_session_id,step_key,run_control_version,definition_sha256,through_at,role_ids,context,opportunities,source_sha256)
 values(sw,p_session,mr.current_step_key,mr.control_version,rb.snapshot_sha256,cutoff,ids,ctx,opps,public.combat_v2_sha256(payload));
 insert into mission_generic_owner.work_items(id,master_session_id,event_id,dedupe_key,step_key,run_control_version,definition_sha256,authority_receipt_id,kind,revision,payload,payload_sha256)
 values(wid,p_session,sw,'director:'||sw,mr.current_step_key,mr.control_version,rb.snapshot_sha256,sw,'director',mr.control_version,payload,public.combat_v2_sha256(payload));
 update mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows set work_id=wid where id=sw;
 update mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_reissues
   set state='enqueued',new_window_id=sw,enqueued_at=clock_timestamp()
   where master_session_id=p_session and state='armed';
 return jsonb_build_object('work_id',wid,'state','director_ready');
end;
